_comment: Reactor settlement tables. Editing this file must NOT require a recompile — that is the whole point of the data-driven architecture note in production/handoff-2026-10-05.md. Loaded at run time by FSubstanceTable::LoadFromJsonFile.

_format.substances: id is required. bIsPrimitive defaults to TRUE when absent — an id that forgot to declare itself must never become a non-terminating recursion branch. color is a placeholder only; real art is out of scope (see design/game-brief.md).
_format.reactions: a and b are an ORDERED pair, matched as written. resultA is what the first cell becomes; omit it to destroy that cell. resultB plus produceB=true keeps the second cell; produceB=false (the default) is merge semantics — the pair collapses into one cell.
_format.params: All tunables live here so rule iteration costs no recompile. workMultiplier is a MEASUREMENT-ONLY stress knob and must stay 0 in any shipped config; see FSimulationParams.
